renata.why: Most of Renata's kit only matters with allies present (W and Bailout's death-save both explicitly can self-target so they still work solo; R only forces enemies to attack by priority and deals no direct damage, moot against a passive dummy). P's %max-health bonus only fires once (it needs the target unmarked, and her own attacks keep refreshing the mark she just applied); Q's recast damage needs a second body to fly through so it never triggers on one target and is dropped; E's converging-rocket description leaves it genuinely ambiguous whether the same lone target can be caught by both the initial burst and the traveling missile.
